scripts.build: tsc && vite build && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.build:server: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.start: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");if(!fs.existsSync("server/dist/server/src/index.js")){require("child_process").execSync("npm run build:server",{stdio:"inherit"})}' && npm run start --prefix server
scripts.test: node src/tests/frontend-contracts.test.js && npx tsx tests/simulation.test.ts && npx tsx tests/fieldlink-messaging.test.ts && npx tsx tests/offline-sync.test.ts
scripts.test:algorithms: npx tsx -e "import { runAllAlgorithmTests } from './tests/algorithms.test.ts'; const res = runAllAlgorithmTests(); console.log(res.logs.join('\n')); if (res.passed !== res.total) process.exit(1);"
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test --prefix server && (python3 tests/run_verification.py || python tests/run_verification.py) && npm run test:algorithms && npm run test:demo
